newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls feeder cattle steady-off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls feeder cattle steady-off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers sold steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, in a narrow test of trade, compared to last Thursday, USDA said.
Receipts - This Week 553 Last Week 560 Last Year 362
Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 950-1000 lbs 73.75-75.50; 1000-1100 lbs 68.00-72.00; Load large 1, 1124 lbs 69.80.
